notes.title: Remote Play Together Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213932/37ccea2dbd38e82835e5080023a7e6f366ddb1fa.png[/img]
Steam's Remote Play Together sale has started and there's no better time to start throwing decapitated heads into fires with your friends! Especially if you're the type of person who can't be bothered going over to your mate's place because they live on the other side of the city.

notes.title: Get ready for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
As part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest, you will be able to download and play a free demo version of Super Head Ball on Steam. The demo is a stripped back version of the game which should keep you busy while we put the finishing touches on the final version!

The festival starts on the 16th of June and runs until the 22nd.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/?emclan=103582791468571009&emgid=3034836460557502332]More on Steam Next Fest[/url]
